name: GuidingCenter scaling (cupy)
description:
Guiding-centre (5D drift-kinetic) test particles in a homogeneous slab, used as the CuPy
multi-GPU/multi-rank strong-scaling case. Np is much larger than params_GuidingCenter.py's
(50,000,000 vs 200,000) so there's enough per-rank compute between marker-exchange calls
for scaling to actually pay off, rather than being dominated by mpi_sort_markers.

custom_commands: echo "Running profiling case: guidingcenter_cupy_scaling (4 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: GuidingCenter particles (Np=50,000,000) on CuPy, strong-scaled across 1-8 GPUs."
echo "Physics problem: Guiding-centre drift-kinetic particle motion; the particle-push hot loop common to all PIC/drift-kinetic models."
echo "Completed profiling case: guidingcenter_cupy_scaling (4 MPI ranks)"
